ddlMissing.s1: schema.pi → mashruuca → modelka jireed → abuurista DDL, mar kale ku dabaq xiriirkan.
ddlMissing.s2: Marka la dhammeeyo, isticmaal "Mar kale samee" hoos oo xaqiiji in tiradu tahay 0.
ddlMissing.s3: Haddii walxaha ay weli maqan yihiin ka dib dib u dabaqidda, ka shakiso hoos u dhac gacmeed ama dib u celin oo la xiriir DBA-gaaga si aad u hubiso dhaqdhaqaaqa akoonka xiriirka.

extraTables.s1: Xirmadan horgaleed ee mashruucan = musharrixiinta moodeelka ka maqan — ku soo deji moodeelka adoo isticmaalaya schema.pi → Settings → Reverse, ama go'aanso inaad tirtirto haddii ay yihiin miisas aan la isticmaalin.
extraTables.s2: Kooxaha horgalaha kale = nidaamyada kale ee wadaaga DB-gan — ma aha waxyaabo ficil ah oo loogu talagalay mashruucan.
extraTables.s3: Haddii schema-da bartilmaameedku aanu ahayn mid guud, beddel goobta "Schema" ee kor ku xusan oo mar kale samee.

colMismatches.s1: Kuma jiraan DB = ku dabaq tiirka modelka DB-da adoo isticmaalaya schema.pi abuurista DDL.
colMismatches.s2: Kuma jirto moodeelka = ku soo deji tiirka DB moodeelka adoo isticmaalaya schema.pi → Settings → Reverse, ama go'aanso inaad tirtirto haddii aan loo baahnayn.
colMismatches.s3: Nooca/NULL way kala duwan yihiin = la jaanqaad modelka (isha runta); ka hor inta aanad gaabin dhererka ama aanad u beddelin NOT NULL, xaqiiji in safafka jira ay buuxiyaan shuruudaha.

idxUsage.s1: Ka hor inta aanad saarin, hubi ① in daaqada tirakoobyada ay daboolayso ugu yaraan hal wareeg ganacsi (tusaale, bisha dhammaadkeeda) — eeg "tan iyo".
idxUsage.s2: ② Ma aha tusmo gaar ah/PK (kuwaas oo si gaar ah u muuqda sida "xaddidaadda gaarnimada").
idxUsage.s3: ③ EXPLAIN SQL-ka matalaya shaxda ee SQL Tuning oo xaqiiji in tusmadan aan la isticmaalin.
idxUsage.s4: Marka saddexdaas la xaqiijiyo, ka saar tusmada modelka ee schema.pi oo ku dabaq DDL.

migration.title: Socdaalka Xogta (PiMig)
migration.intro: Waxay xisaabisaa amarka rarista miiska ee ka yimid xiriirka ku jira schema.pi model naqshadayntaada, waxay abaabushaa cabbirka qaybta, isbarbardhigga iyo liiska hubinta goynta, waxayna abuurtaa SQL xaqiijinta oo aad adigu ku socodsiiso isha iyo bartilmaameedka. Shaashaddan waxay qorsheysaa oo kaliya hubisaa — ma dhaqaajiso xogta ama ma akhrido safafka DB ee macmiilka.
migration.needLink: Marka hore dooro isku xirka schema.pi ee kor ku xusan. Haddii aadan midna haysan, diiwaangeli calaamad ku jirta menu-ka 'Isku xirka'.
migration.snapHint: Naqshadaynta wakhtigan (magacyada miiska, tiirarka iyo xiriirka) waxaa loo qaboojiyaa sidii sawir. Abuur qorshe cusub marka model-ka isbeddelo.
migration.dropped: ({n} xiriirro aan lahayn miisas jireed ayaa laga saaray kala-soocidda)
migration.optsHint: Isbarbardhiggu waa tirada miisaska la soo shubay isku mar gudaha heer. Cabbirka qaybta waa cutubka commit (safaf) ee matoorka fulintu isticmaali doono.
migration.orderHint: Si topoloji ahaan ayaa loo kala soocay xiriirrada naqshadeynta (ma aha FKs jireed) si miisaska waalidku u horreeyaan. Miisaska isku heerka ah isku tiirsanaan ma leh waxaana lagu rari karaa si isku mid ah.
migration.cycles: {n} koox(o) wareeg ah — oo la dhigay isku heer. Gacanta ku hagaaji amarkooda oo dib u dhig hubinta tixraaca ilaa inta la rarayo ka dib.

valueConv.title: Beddelidda qiimaha
valueConv.desc: Xeerarka ayaa loo dejiyay xarig madhan = NULL, CHAR buuxinta bannaan, NUMBER aan lahayn saxnaan → NUMERIC, DATE oo leh wakhti → TIMESTAMP, VARCHAR2 BYTE ↔ CHAR dhererka, iyo LONG·RAW.

timezone.title: Aagga wakhtiga · tiirarka nidaamka
timezone.desc: Aagga wakhtiga fasiraadda ee qiimayaasha aan lahayn mid (tusaale Asia/Seoul) waa la dejiyay, kiciyeyaasha wakhtiga la beddelay ma dul-saari doonaan wakhtiyada isha inta lagu jiro raridda, waxaana la dejiyay xeerarka beddelidda abuuraha/wax-ka-beddelaha.

backpressure.title: Cadaadis dhabar · raridda bartilmaameedka
backpressure.desc: Yaree cabbirka qaybta iyo isbarbardhigga dib-u-dhaca bartilmaameedka, koritaanka WAL ama sugitaanka qufulka; dhis tusmooyinka aan-PK ahayn ka dib marka la raro oo ku socodsii ANALYZE·VACUUM ka dib.

migration.verifyHint: Wuxuu soo saaraa tirada, wadarta tiirka nambarada, furaha nuqulka ah iyo furaha hash ee miiska kasta oo ku jira amarka raridda. Adigu ku socodsii isha iyo bartilmaameedka oo isbarbardhig (shaashaddani ma fuliso).
migration.noHashOracle: Oracle·Tibero hawlaha hash iyo soo-bandhigidda qoraalka way ka duwan yihiin PostgreSQL, sidaa darteed su'aalaha hash waa laga tagay — isbarbardhig tirada, wadarta iyo furayaasha nuqulka ah.

fix.AVAIL: Jawaab gaabis ah ama dib u bilow dhowaan ah — hubi goobaha xidhiidhka iyo heerka server-ka DB.
fix.AVAIL_DOWN: Kuma xidhnaan karo DB — hubi goobaha xidhiidhka iyo in server-ka DB uu shaqaynayo.
fix.CONN_USE: {sess}/{max} fadhiyada DB-gan (ma aha guud ahaan kooxda — xogaha kale waa laga saaray) — xidh xidhiidhada aan shaqaynayn ama ku dar barkad xidhiidh (pgbouncer).
fix.URL: {n} URL-yada la hubiyay oo fashilmay · jawaabta ugu badan {ms}ms — eeg kormeeraha schema.pi sababta.
fix.LONG_QRY: Weydiin ayaa socotay {sec}s — dib u eeg qorshaheeda oo hagaaji, ama DBA ha joojiyo.
fix.IDLE_TX: Wax kala iibsi ayaa aan shaqaynayn {sec}s — ka hel ballanqaadka maqan ee abka oo deji wakhti xaddidan.
fix.LOCK_WAIT: {n} fadhi ayaa sugaya qufullo — hel fadhiga xannibaya oo soo afjar wax kala iibsigiisa.
fix.CACHE_HIT: Heerka garaaca kaydka {pct}% — raadi baadhitaanno buuxa oo miisaska waaweyn ah ama dib u eeg shared_buffers.
fix.XACT_ERR: Heerka dib u celinta {pct}%, {dlck} isku-xidhka — hubi wax kala iibsiga fashilmay iyo diiwaannada qaladka abka.
fix.SLOW_SQL: Waxaa jira su'aal qaadata ilaa {ms}ms hal mar – eeg qorshaha fulinta oo hagaaji, adigoo ka bilaabaya wakhtiga ugu sarreeya ee hal fulin.
fix.STORAGE: DB ({gb} GB) wuxuu ku dhow yahay xaddidkiisa (maalmaha ka hadhay {days}) — nadiifi miisaska waaweyn ama ku dar awood.
fix.VACUUM: {tbl} wuxuu leeyahay safaf badan oo dhintay ama tirakoob duugoobay — dib u eeg goobaha VACUUM (ANALYZE) iyo autovacuum.
fix.INDEX: {n} natiijooyinka tusmada (ansax la'aan, aan la isticmaalin, baadhitaanno buuxa) — eeg tabka caafimaadka miiska & tusmada ee bartilmaameedyada.
fix.BACKUP: Kaydinta WAL waa dansan tahay ama way istaagtay — hubi archive_mode, archive_command iyo heerka kaydinta.
fix.REPL: Dib u dhaca koobiyeynta {sec}s — hubi heerka heeganka iyo shabakadda.
fix.PGSS: pg_stat_statements lama rakibin, sidaa darteed SQL gaabiska ah lama heli karo — ku shaqeysii SQL-ka hoose (dib u bilowga server-ka ayaa loo baahan yahay).

reason.CONN_DOWN: Lama xukumin sababtoo ah xidhiidhka DB waa dansan yahay.
reason.VER: Waxa laga heli karaa PostgreSQL 13 ama ka dib.
reason.SAMPLE: Weli ma jiraan muunado ku filan.
reason.NO_LIMIT: Ma jiro xaddidaad cabbir ah, sidaa darteed isticmaalka lama xukumin — ku dar xeer cabbirka DB (MB) (>) si aad ugu isticmaasho xaddidaad ahaan.
reason.RESET: Tirakoobka dib looma dajin wax ka yar 7 maalmood ka hor, sidaa darteed tusmooyinka aan la isticmaalin lama xukumin.
reason.STALE: Ma jiraan diiwaanno hubin dhowaan ah.
reason.GRANT: Mudnaanta maqan — ku dar doorka pg_monitor akoonka xidhiidhka.

AVAIL.1: Hubi heerka xidhiidhka ee Xidhiidhada, oo hagaaji goobaha xidhiidhka (martigeliyaha, dekedda, akoonka) ee schema.pi.
AVAIL.2: Hubi in server-ka DB uu shaqaynayo iyo inuu dib u bilowday dhowaan.
AVAIL.3: Haddii ay sii gaabis tahay, hubi culayska server-ka (CPU, disk) iyo shabakadda.

CONN_USE.1: Eeg tirada fadhiyada ee isticmaale iyo heerka tabka hawsha & qufulka.
CONN_USE.2: Haddii ay badan yihiin kuwa aan shaqaynayn, yaree barkadda abka ama ku dar barkad xidhiidh.
CONN_USE.3: Si taxaddar leh u kordhi max_connections, adoo tixgelinaya xusuusta.

URL.1: Eeg URL-yada fashilmay iyo koodhadhka heerka ee kormeeraha schema.pi.
URL.2: Hubi geynta abka iyo ku tiirsanaanta dibadda.
URL.3: Haddii ay ku celceliso, ku dar xeer tirada fashilka URL (URL_FAIL_CNT).

LONG_QRY.1: Ka hel weydiimaha socda muddo dheer iyo isticmaalayaashooda tabka hawsha & qufulka.
LONG_QRY.2: Dib u eeg qorshaha hagaajinta SQL oo hagaaji tusmooyinka ama shuruudaha.
LONG_QRY.3: Haddii ay degdeg tahay, DBA wuxuu ku joojinayaa pg_cancel_backend.

IDLE_TX.1: Eeg weydiinta u dambaysay ee fadhiyada aan shaqaynayn ee wax kala iibsiga tabka hawsha & qufulka.
IDLE_TX.2: Ka hel ballanqaadka maqan ama dib u celinta koodhka abka.

LOCK_WAIT.1: Ka hel fadhiga xannibaya (blocked_by) tabka hawsha & qufulka.
LOCK_WAIT.2: Soo afjar wax kala iibsigiisa ama DBA ha joojiyo.
LOCK_WAIT.3: Hagaaji dufcadaha ama nidaamka wax kala iibsiga ee haya safaf isku mid ah muddo dheer.

CACHE_HIT.1: Ka hel baadhitaanno buuxa oo miisaska waaweyn ah tabka weydiinta gaabiska ah.
CACHE_HIT.2: Ku dar tusmooyinka loo baahan yahay si aad u akhrido baloogyo yar.
CACHE_HIT.3: Haddii xusuusta ay ogolaato, dib u eeg shared_buffers.

XACT_ERR.1: Ka hel sababaha dib u celinta (jabin xaddidaad, wakhti xaddidan) diiwaannada qaladka abka.
XACT_ERR.2: Haddii ay jiraan isku-xidhka, quful miisaska si isku mid ah.
XACT_ERR.3: Hubi in macquulka dib u celinta uusan kor u qaadin dib u celinta.

SLOW_SQL.1: Tabka su'aalaha gaabiska ah, ka dooro su'aasha leh wakhtiga ugu sarreeya ee hal fulin.
SLOW_SQL.2: Dib u eeg qorshayaasha hagaajinta SQL oo hagaaji tusmooyinka ama isku-xidhka.
SLOW_SQL.3: Kadib hagaajinta, dib u deji tirakoobyada (pg_stat_statements_reset) oo mar kale hubi in wakhtiga ugu sarreeya ee hal fulin uu hoos u dhacay.

STORAGE.1: Eeg isbeddelka koritaanka iyo taariikhda buuxda ee la qiyaasay tabka isbeddelka cabbirka.
STORAGE.2: Nadiifi miisaska waaweyn, tusmooyinka iyo xogta duugowday.
STORAGE.3: Haddii loo baahdo, ku dar disk oo cusboonaysii xeerka xaddidaadda.

VACUUM.1: Eeg miisaska leh safaf badan oo dhintay tabka caafimaadka miiska & tusmada.
VACUUM.3: Haddii ay ku celceliso, hoos u dhig xaddidaadaha autovacuum ee miiskaas.

INDEX.1: Eeg tusmooyinka ansax la'aanta ah ama aan la isticmaalin iyo miisaska baadhitaanka buuxa ee tabka caafimaadka miiska & tusmada.
INDEX.2: Dib u dhis tusmooyinka ansax la'aanta ah; DBA wuxuu dib u eegaa oo tirtiraa kuwa aan la isticmaalin.
INDEX.3: Naqshadee tusmooyinka hagaajinta SQL ee miisaska leh baadhitaanno buuxa oo badan.

BACKUP.1: Eeg archive_mode iyo wakhtiga kaydinta u dambaysay tabka kaydinta & soo kabashada.
BACKUP.2: Haddii kaydinta ay fashilanto, hubi archive_command iyo meesha bannaan ee meesha loo socdo.
BACKUP.3: DB la maamulo, hubi goobaha kaydinta ee bixiyaha.

REPL.1: Eeg heerka iyo dib u dhaca heegan kasta tabka koobiyeynta & DR.
REPL.2: Hubi disk, CPU iyo shabakadda heeganka.
REPL.3: Haddii aysan socon, hubi diiwaannada heeganka.

rules.wm_default: Heerka caadiga ah (4MB). Kala-soocidda waaweyn iyo hashes-ku waxay ku daadan karaan diskiga
rules.mwm_default: Heerka caadiga ah (64MB). VACUUM iyo dhismaha tusmooyinka ayaa laga yaabaa inay gaabis noqdaan; tixgeli 256MB ama ka badan

rules.av_off: autovacuum waa dansan yahay. Khatar sare oo ah bararka miiska iyo wareegga aqoonsiga macaamilka
rules.conn_high: max_connections waa sare. Isku xir kasta wuxuu isticmaalaa xusuus; pooler (PgBouncer iwm.) ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.lmd_off: Log-ga su'aalaha gaabiska ah waa dansan yahay (-1). Qiyaastii 1000ms ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.lmd_all: Qoraal kasta waa la diiwaangeliyaa (0). Culeys badan oo log-ga ah
rules.lmd_ok: Log-ga su'aalaha gaabiska ah waa daaran yahay
rules.st_off: Ma jiro wakhti-xaddidid qoraal oo server-ka oo dhan ah (0). Deji xaddidaadyo door kasta ama codsi kasta
rules.iit_off: Ma jiro wakhti-xaddidid aan shaqaynayn-gudaha-macaamilka (0). Waxay sababi kartaa quful hayn iyo barar
rules.iit_ok: Wakhti-xaddidid aan shaqaynayn-gudaha-macaamilka waa la dejiyay
rules.ckpt_short: Wakhtiga hubinta waa 5 daqiiqo ama ka yar. Tixgeli 10–15 daqiiqo culeysyada qorista ee badan
rules.wal_minimal: wal_level=minimal wuxuu ka dhigayaa PITR iyo koobiyeynta mid aan suurtagal ahayn. Isticmaal replica ama ka sareeya
rules.wal_ok: Heerka WAL wuxuu taageeraa PITR iyo koobiyeynta
rules.rpc_hdd: HDD default (4). SSD, 1.1–2 ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.super_many: Laba ama ka badan superusers. Mid u hayso maamulka oo kuwa kale si kaliya mudnaanta loo baahan yahay

rules.bypass_ok: Ma jiraan doorar RLS-ka ka gudba

rules.expiry_ok: Dhammaan doorarka gelitaanka waxay leeyihiin dhicitaan
rules.public_grant: PUBLIC (door kasta) wuxuu leeyahay mudnaanta miiska. Mudnaanta qorista waa khatar
rules.public_ok: Ma jiraan mudnaanta miiska oo loo siiyay PUBLIC
rules.arc_off: Kaydinta WAL waa dansan tahay, sidaa darteed soo kabashada wakhtiga (PITR) waa mid aan suurtagal ahayn

pgss.title: Sida loo daaro pg_stat_statements

src.root: Si si sax ah loo ogaado isha: (1) isticmaal akoon DB gaar ah barnaamij kasta, dufcad kasta iyo qof kasta (qalab), iyo (2) deji application_name xiriir kasta. Akoonka wuxuu ka yimaadaa pg_stat_statements waana hubaal; qaybta app/qalabka waxaa lagu qiyaasaa muunado dhaqdhaqaaq (application_name waxaa iska soo sheega macmiilka, sidaa darteed wuu madhnaan karaa ama isbeddeli karaa, iyo weydiimaha gaaban ee ku dhammaada inta u dhaxaysa muunado waa la seegi karaa)

fix.TOOL: Waxay u egtahay qof si toos ah u weydiinaya DB-da wax-soo-saarka isagoo isticmaalaya qalab DB (DBeaver iwm.). U tilmaan nuqul akhris-kaliya ah ama DB falanqayn ah, oo xaddid wakhtiga socodka akoonnada aadanaha, tusaale ahaan ALTER ROLE human_user SET statement_timeout = '30s'. Isticmaal door akhris-kaliya ah oo gaar ah, oo samee soo saaridda tiro badan saacadaha aan mashquulka ahayn
fix.BATCH: Waxay u egtahay dufcad ama shaqo la qorsheeyay. Faafi wakhtiyada socodka si ay uga fogaadaan meelaha ugu sarreeya ee ganacsiga oo yaree shaqada halkii ballanqaad. Hubi tusmooyinka iyo tirakoobyada (ANALYZE) ee shaxda bartilmaameedka, oo kala qaybi macaamilada dhaadheer. Ku darista magaca shaqada application_name waxay ka dhigaysaa kala-saaridda xigta mid sax ah
fix.PROGRAM: Tani waxay u muuqataa inay tahay su'aal ay fulisay codsiga. Hubi qorshaha fulinta ee hagaajinta SQL. Haddii wakhtiga ugu sarreeya ee hal fulin uu dheer yahay, marka hore eeg tusmooyinka iyo nidaamka isku xirka. Haddii hal fulin ay gaaban tahay laakiin tirada wicitaanada ay badan tahay, eeg wicitaanada soo noqnoqda (N+1) iyo kaydinta. Ku rid magaca adeegga application_name ee barkadda isku xirka.
fix.PLATFORM: Waxay u egtahay shaqo gudaha ah oo DB ama madal ah sida autovacuum ama nuqul-samayn. Badanaa wax ficil ah looma baahna. Haddii ay ku sii jirto meesha ugu sarreysa, dib u eeg marinka autovacuum iyo maintenance_work_mem
fix.MONITOR: Tani waa su'aal is-ururin ah oo dbms.pi ah — isku-xirka schema.pi waa weedh go'an oo kaliya akhrisa aragtiyaha/buug-yaraha tirakoobyada (pg_stat_*·pg_catalog), sidaa darteed ma aha su'aal ganacsi mana u baahna tallaabo macmiil. Haddii culeyska xogta bartilmaameedku yahay dhibaato, yaree tirada jeer ee aad furto badhanka ururinta/shaashadda la socodka. Weedhaha ka imanaya qalabka kale ee la socodka ee akhriya isla aragtiyaha tirakoobyada ayaa sidoo kale halkan lagu soo ururiyaa.
fix.UNKNOWN: Ma jirto wax tilmaan ah oo ku saabsan isha. Deji application_name xiriir kasta oo kala qaybi akoonnada ujeeddooyin kala duwan; waxaa lagu kala saari doonaa muunadaha xiga

diag.title: Baadh Sababta
diag.none: Ma jirto sabab ay tirakoobyadu muujiyeen — ka eeg qorshaha fulinta SQL Tuning.
diag.cum: Ma jiraan wicitaanno muddadan — isku-darka (tan iyo markii dib loo dejiyay tirakoobyada)
diag.basis: Saldhig — Ugu badnaan 1-mar {max}ms · Celcelis {mean}ms · Wicitaannada {calls} · Safafka wicitaan kasta {rpc} · Heerka akhriska diskiga {read} · Xannibaadaha ku-meel-gaadhka ah {tmp}

SELF_MON.cause: dbms.pi su'aal is-ururin ah — odhaah la socod ah oo akhrinaysa kaliya aragtiyada tirakoobyada/buugaagta.
SELF_MON.fix: Ma jirto tallaabo macmiil oo loo baahan yahay. Haddii culeyska xogta bartilmaameedku uu yahay dhibaato, yaree tirada jeer ee aad furto shaashadda ururinta/la socodka.

NO_MAX.cause: Ururin hore oo aan lahayn qiime 'ugu sarreeya 1-mar', sidaa darteed lama kala saari karo 'mar walba gaabis/dib u dhac goos-goos ah'.
NO_MAX.fix: Hadda hal mar guji 'Ururi' si aad u buuxiso qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee baadhista saxda ah.

SLOW_EACH.cause: Mar walba gaabis — Waxay qaadataa wakhti dheer mar kasta oo ay socoto, iyada oo ugu badnaan {max}ms iyo celcelis {mean}ms.
SLOW_EACH.fix: ① Fur qorshaha fulinta 'Fur SQL Tuning'. ② Haddii ay jiraan baadhitaanno buuxa (Seq Scan) ama kala-soocid waaweyn, dib u eeg tusmooyinka ku jira shuruudaha WHERE/JOIN. ③ Yaree shuruudaha si aad u akhrido kaliya tiirarka/safafka lagama maarmaanka ah.

SPIKE.cause: Dib u dhac goos-goos ah — Celcelis {mean}ms, laakiin mararka qaarkood waxay qaadataa wakhti dheer oo ugu badnaan {max}ms ({x} jeer celceliska).
SPIKE.fix: ① Marka ay gaabis tahay, ka eeg sugitaanka qufulka (wait_event) tabka Hawsha/Qufulka. ② Haddii fulinta koowaad oo kaliya ay gaabis tahay, kaydku wuu madhnaa oo diskiga ayaa la akhriyay. ③ Isbarbardhig su'aasha isku midka ah oo leh qiimayaal kala duwan SQL Tuning si aad u aragto haddii qorshaha fulinta uu isbeddelo iyadoo lagu saleynayo qiimaha.

DISK_READ.cause: Cache Miss — {pct}% ({read} blocks) oo ka mid ah xannibaadaha la akhriyay ayaa laga akhriyay diskiga, ma aha xusuusta.
DISK_READ.fix: ① Yaree inta la akhrinayo tusmooyinka. ② Yaree muddada/shuruudaha su'aasha. ③ Haddii xogta si joogto ah loo akhriyo ay sii ahaanayso mid sare, dib u eeg shared_buffers (xusuusta).

TEMP_SPILL.cause: Xusuusta oo buux dhaaftay — Kala-soocidda/hash-ka ayaa ka batay work_mem oo waxay ku qortay {blk} blocks (qiyaastii {mb}MB, {perCall} blocks wicitaan kasta) faylasha ku-meel-gaadhka ah.
TEMP_SPILL.fix: ① Ku dhejinta tusmooyinka tiirarka ORDER BY/GROUP BY waxay ka booddaa kala-soocidda. ② Marka hore, yaree tirada safafka la kala-soocayo (LIMIT gudaha). ③ Haddii ay gabi ahaanba lagama maarmaan tahay, kordhi SET LOCAL work_mem kaliya macaamilka su'aashan.

MANY_ROWS.cause: Soo-celin xad-dhaaf ah — Waxay soo qaadataa {perCall} saf wicitaan kasta.
MANY_ROWS.fix: ① Liisaska shaashadda waxaa lagu soo qaadaa bog-bog. ② SELECT waxay doorataa kaliya tiirarka la isticmaalo. ③ Isku-darka waxaa lagu sameeyaa xogta, waxaana la helaa kaliya natiijooyinka.

PGRST_EMBED.cause: PostgREST odhaahda shaandhaynta la dhex-geliyay (!inner) — shaandhaynta waalidka iyadoo la adeegsanayo shuruudaha ilmaha waxay baadhi kartaa dhammaan qaybta ka hor shuruudaha kala-saaridda.
PGRST_EMBED.fix: ① Hubi in ay jiraan tusmooyin ku saabsan furayaasha isku-dhafka iyo tiirarka shaandhaynta. ② Shaandhaynta u wareeji shuruudaha miiska waalidka. ③ Carruurta ku dhex dar weydiin waalid oo hore u jirtay ama ku biir hal shaqo xogeed.

OFFSET_PAGING.cause: OFFSET Paging — Waxay si tartiib tartiib ah u gaabisaysaa marka ay akhrido oo ay iska tuurto safafka hore ee bogagga dambe.
OFFSET_PAGING.fix: U beddel keyset paging (WHERE id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT n) kaas oo ka akhriya furaha ka dambeeya furaha ugu dambeeyay ee la helay.

pipeline.title: PiCDC · Dhuumaha
pipeline.intro: Hubi in DB-ga isha uu diyaar u yahay qabashada xogta isbeddelka (CDC) oo naqshadee isha → beddel → dhuumaha bartilmaameedka. Marxaladdan waxay kaliya hubisaa oo naqshadeysaa; ma jiraan xog saf ah oo macmiil ah oo la akhriyo ama la kaydiyo.
pipeline.needLink: Marka hore dooro xiriirka schema.pi ee kor ku xusan. Haddii aadan midna lahayn, iska diiwaan geli calaamad ku taal menu-ka 'Xiriir'.

pipeline.runBody: Fulinta dhuumaha, la socodka dib u dhaca iyo dib u habaynta waxay yimaadaan marka wakiilka shaqaalaha iyo qaabka amniga la dhammaystiro. Hadda, ku kaydi qeexitaannada sidii qabyo qoraal (DRAFT).

codes.SELECT_STAR: SELECT * — dooro kaliya tiirarka aad u baahan tahay (I/O dheeraad ah, ma jiro tusmo daboolaya).
codes.FUNC_ON_COLUMN: Tiirka shaandhada {column} waxaa lagu duubay hawlgal ama muujin, sidaa darteed tusmaheeda lama isticmaali karo — beddel joogtada ah.
codes.LEADING_WILDCARD: LIKE oo leh % hormood ah ma isticmaali karo tusmo B-tree ah — tixgeli tusmo pg_trgm GIN ah.
codes.OR_DIFF_COLUMNS: Shuruudaha OR ee ku saabsan tiirar kala duwan — tixgeli in lagu kala qaybiyo UNION (ku dar shuruud ka saarista nuqul haddii UNION ALL) ama dib u eeg tusmooyinka tiir kasta.
codes.IMPLICIT_CAST: {column} waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa tiro la soo xigtay — isku dheji tiirka iyo noocyada joogtada ah (implicit cast).
codes.NOT_IN_SUBQUERY: NOT IN (subquery) waxba ma soo celiso marka NULLs ay jiraan waana gaabis — isticmaal NOT EXISTS.
codes.NO_WHERE: Ma jiro WHERE clause — shaxad weyn tani waa baadhitaan buuxa (ku dar shuruud ama LIMIT).
codes.DOMAIN_MISMATCH: {column} waa nooc {expected} ah oo ku salaysan domain-ka caadiga ah laakiin waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa joogto nooc kale ah — implicit cast-ka ayaa laga yaabaa inuu ka hortago isticmaalka tusmada.

ai.title: Talooyinka AI tuning
ai.intro: Dooro hal qorshe oo la kaydiyay si aad talo u abuurto. Kaliya SQL iyo qorshayaasha leh constants oo lagu qariyay ? ayaa la diraa (talo ku saleysan sharci haddii aan fure lahayn ama haddii ay dhacdo guuldarro). Ka dib marka milkiilaha xiriirku ansixiyo, dib u socodsii sharaxaadda SQL isku mid ah, kaydi, oo cabbir saameynta qorshahaas dambe — kaliya markaas ayaa loo diiwaan gelinayaa in la hirgeliyay.

ai.noPlans: Ma jiraan qorshayaal la kaydiyay. Fiiri qorshe sharaxaad ah oo kor ku xusan ka dibna kaydi.
ai.note: Hal talo qorshe kasta. Tirtir talada jira si aad dib ugu abuurto. DDL kaliya waa la soo jeediyaa — ku dabaq schema.pi.

rule.SELECT_STAR: Dooro kaliya tiirarka aad u baahan tahay halkii aad ka dooran lahayd SELECT * (I/O yar, tusmooyinka daboolaya waa suurtagal).

rule.IMPLICIT_CAST: Isbarbar dhig noocyada {column} iyo joogtada ah (ka saar tuurista qarsoon).
rule.NOT_IN_SUBQUERY: Dib u qor NOT IN (subquery) sida NOT EXISTS.
rule.OR_DIFF_COLUMNS: Shuruudaha OR ee tiirarka kala duwan waa in lagu kala qaybiyo UNION (ku dar shuruud ka saarista nuqul kan dambe haddii UNION ALL) ama ay yeeshaan tusmooyin tiir kasta (BitmapOr).
